Definition: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.
BiblicalUsage: Oikos is a house, a dwelling, and by extension a family. Jesus tells the paralysed man to arise and go to his house in Matthew 9:6, and in Mark 2:1 it is noised that He is in the house at Capernaum.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the house is where Jesus goes to work, and the family under its roof is the first congregation.
